partition_rule: meetings.xml: type=scenario and visibility=unseen; verify against ES2004, ES2014, IS1009, TS3003, TS3007, a-d
casual_chat_priority: Prioritize actual top.14 chitchat intervals before meeting/work fill. This partition consists of scenario design-team meetings, but ES2014d contains one sparse labelled chitchat interval, 2550.541–2640.240 seconds. Do not relabel surrounding meeting speech as casual chat.
eligibility: Manual words plus dialogue acts for all four participants, finite word times, verified participant-to-headset map; chunks contain at least 80 target lexical words, every scored word has a source manual dialogue-act assignment, no target word cut at either edge, and no invalid nonword timestamp region crossed. Exclude whole sessions with unbounded events or invalid lexical times; do not repair source annotations by guessing.
selection: Seeded shuffle of eligible sessions and dialogue-act starts. Four general chunks rotate A/B/C/D; two separately ranked stress chunks rotate A/B. Two development chunks rotate C/D and use sessions absent from main. Isolated utterances use sessions absent from main and development. Director independently owns nonspeech background material.
normalization: One constant gain per rendered chunk to -3 dBFS peak, PCM signed 16-bit; no dynamics/time stretching.
compression: Between consecutive target lexical/vocal events, gaps longer than 8 seconds containing at least 1 second of other-speaker word activity are reduced to 3 seconds by retaining the first and last 1.5 seconds. Target gaps without other-speaker words and all target gaps <=8 seconds remain unchanged.
edge_rule: Start at a dialogue-act boundary with up to 0.25 seconds preroll, avoiding crossing any target event. If the exact transformed budget would bisect a target event, stop at that event's start and explicitly pad at most two seconds with digital silence. Padding is not speech and is separately mapped.
isolated: 20 complete target dialogue acts from held-out TS3007a evaluation material: seven short <=2s, six long >=8s, seven internally paused >=0.3s candidates; selection buckets may overlap acoustically but selected source dialogue acts are distinct. Exact first-to-last lexical boundaries, no added guards. Not synthetic or reconstructed utterances.
repeat_budget: First 298-second general chunk plus its following 2-second separator, exactly a 300-second prefix of main.

stress_criteria.internal_pause: Consecutive target lexical words within one dialogue act, >=0.300 seconds gap, no intervening corpus terminal punctuation (.?!); time-derived candidate, not independent acoustic or syntactic validation.
stress_criteria.cross_sentence_continuation: Corpus terminal punctuation followed by the same speaker's next lexical word within 0.300 seconds; heuristic for continuing speech, not a semantic sentence judgment.
stress_criteria.trailing_filler: Final lexical token of a dialogue act belongs to {uh, um, er, erm, hmm, mm}; lexical heuristic, uncertain pragmatic role.
stress_criteria.backchannel: AMI dialogue act type ami_da_1 (Backchannel), not inferred from a token dictionary.

stress_ranking: Count eligible observed target events; select separately from general after excluding its sessions. No equal-count quota and no manufactured stress speech.
reference: AMI human orthographic transcript; corpus-provided word alignment times (not independently verified); reference sentence units are original AMI dialogue acts, turns are chronological speaker-label changes with overlap retained.
publication: LOCAL DATA ONLY. No upload. Audio and downloads are excluded from Git. Retain AMI CC BY 4.0 attribution and modification notice.
